# Quizlet Integration for Flashcards
import requests

QUIZLET_CLIENT_ID = "47368421052631578947368421052632"
QUIZLET_SECRET = "your_secret"

def create_flashcard_set(title, terms, definitions):
    """Create flashcard set on Quizlet"""
    response = requests.post(
        "https://api.quizlet.com/2.0/sets",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {QUIZLET_CLIENT_ID}"},
        data={
            "title": title,
            "lang_terms": "en",
            "lang_definitions": "en"
        }
    )
    
    set_id = response.json().get("id")
    
    # Add terms
    for term, definition in zip(terms, definitions):
        requests.post(
            f"https://api.quizlet.com/2.0/sets/{set_id}/terms",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {QUIZLET_CLIENT_ID}"},
            data={
                "term": term,
                "definition": definition
            }
        )
    
    return set_id
